name: kettlebells sumo deadlift
description: A wide-stance deadlift with a kettlebell or two that trains the glutes, inner thighs and legs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, kettlebells on the floor between your feet.
Hinge down and grip the handles with a flat back.
Push through your feet and stand up, squeezing your glutes.
Keep the kettlebells close to your body.
Lower back down by hinging at the hips.
